documents.title: BT0035 - Policy on Artificial Intelligence
documents.summary: UT System Board of Trustees policy BT0035, covering UT Knoxville, embraces AI but requires each instructor to decide and communicate the permitted use, with unpermitted use treated as misconduct. It sets minimum campus procedures, bars detector results from being the sole measure, and restricts protected data in unreviewed AI tools.
documents.stance_why: The policy says faculty 'shall consider whether, when, and how AI may be used, if at all' and lists three options (Unrestricted, Mixed, Total Prohibition) as examples, so it sets no default itself and hands the decision to instructors; it also lists tiers, so delegates.

units.policy: The Board of Trustees adopts this policy on the use of AI by students, faculty and staff for instructional and assignment purposes, as required by Tennessee Public Chapter 550 (2024).
